name: Basic Electronics Company Ltd (Al-Asasyah)
note: Al-Khobar-based electronics and appliances company; the club's partners page links the Al-Asasyah mark to al-asasyah.com. Its GREE section (al-asasyah.com/new/ar/gree/) describes Basic Electronics Company Ltd as the agent ('وكيلنا') of the GREE air-conditioner brand in Saudi Arabia.
